anti_duplication.rule: Preserve the exact attempt-3 subject until terminal executed evidence or explicit invalidation.

new_primary_evidence.fact: A Qwen3-ASR /v1/realtime multi-turn report reproduces second-utterance transcription reusing the first utterance under KV reuse in the same WebSocket session.
new_primary_evidence.project_effect: Add an exact multi-turn no-history-copy discriminator to the ASR004 long-session comparator. This is not yet a Frankenstein product failure because it is upstream/environment-specific and has not been reproduced on the admitted target.

new_primary_evidence.fact: The Qwen maintainer states the open streaming implementation did not implement KV-cache reuse and was still far from industrial implementation.
new_primary_evidence.project_effect: Streaming quality must be measured causally; model-card streaming claims cannot substitute for a bounded-cost, stable multi-turn runtime test.

new_primary_evidence.fact: SGLang documents that Qwen3-ASR chunked streaming re-encodes cumulative audio unless bounded sliding-window/segment streaming is used and proposes server-side VAD plus bounded windows.
new_primary_evidence.project_effect: Record cumulative-compute growth and segment-boundary accuracy as separate discriminators; do not equate token streaming with bounded-cost realtime ASR.

new_primary_evidence.fact: Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B is cache-aware FastConformer-RNNT, explicitly supports de-DE as transcription-ready, and exposes configurable 80/160/320/560/1120 ms streaming chunks; official FLEURS German WER is reported from 9.81 down to 8.31 across those operating points.
new_primary_evidence.project_effect: Keep T7-ASR-008 as the next distinct streaming challenger after ASR004 is measured/reconciled; published metrics remain source-priority evidence only.

required_asr004_discriminator_addition.name: MULTITURN_HISTORY_COPY_AND_COST_GROWTH
minimum_shape: at least two semantically distinct German utterances
assert utterance N output does not copy prior utterance text
record per-turn latency and compute/resource growth across repeated turns
retain deterministic VAD/turn-gated Qwen3-ASR and faster-whisper matched-audio baseline
preserve silence false-positive discriminator already observed

hypothesis: Qwen3-ASR may still be competitive for German single-turn latency/quality while failing long-session realtime stability or bounded-cost streaming; the repaired ASR004 target comparator can separate those claims without reopening architecture.
counterhypothesis: The upstream KV-reuse/history-copy issue may be specific to vLLM configuration or 1.7B and may not reproduce on the exact 0.6B target path; therefore it must remain a falsifier until target evidence exists.
next_exact_action: Consume the first exact persisted ASR004 attempt-3 receipt. If nonterminal, do not redispatch. If valid target execution succeeds, extend the already-routed identical-audio German/noise comparator with the multi-turn no-history-copy and per-turn cost-growth discriminator before promoting streaming quality. Then, only after ASR004 measurement or explicit reconciliation, run T7-ASR-008 Nemotron 3.5 on the identical comparator.
